title: N37: VRP threshold justification + kurtosis collapse + skewness caveat added to paper
description: Added three key findings to paper: (1) VRP threshold 1.3 = long-run VIX/GARCH median 1.31 — principled justification, not ad hoc. (2) Kurtosis collapse: BH 13.24 → HVT 2.85 (78% reduction, concentrated in crisis years). Worst day -10.94% → -3.01%. Sortino +22%. (3) Skewness caveat: HVT skew -0.59 > BH -0.29 (more negative) due to VIX 15-20 deleveraging missing bounces. But all downside metrics unanimously favor HVT — cosmetic not harmful.
